# `m.reference.conditions`

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

The trade and quote condition codes, with what each means and how it updates bars.

```python
m.reference.conditions(*, asset_class=None, data_type=None, condition_id=None, sip=None, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None)
```

[All datasets](README.md)

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Verbs | `fetch()`, `poll()` |
| Served by | REST |
| `poll()` | `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`: holds exactly the latest cycle's rows, keyed by `AssetClass`, `Type`, `Id`, `Name`, `DataTypes`, `Abbreviation`, `Description`, `Exchange`, `Legacy`, `SipMappingCta`, `SipMappingOpra`, `SipMappingUtp`, `SipMappingFinraTdds`, `UpdateRulesConsolidatedUpdatesHighLow`, `UpdateRulesConsolidatedUpdatesOpenClose`, `UpdateRulesConsolidatedUpdatesVolume`, `UpdateRulesMarketCenterUpdatesHighLow`, `UpdateRulesMarketCenterUpdatesOpenClose` and `UpdateRulesMarketCenterUpdatesVolume` |
| `sort` | `asset_class`, `id`, `type`, `name`, `data_types`, `legacy` |
| `filters` | none |

## Arguments

What each argument does for this dataset, and the rule it follows for every dataset that takes it.

| Argument | For this dataset | For every dataset |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `asset_class` | The asset class whose conditions to list; leave it out for every class. Massive lists no futures or index conditions. |  |
| `data_type` | The kind of data the conditions apply to; leave it out for every kind. |  |
| `condition_id` | One condition's id; leave it out for every condition. |  |
| `sip` | The SIP whose condition codes to list; leave it out for every SIP. |  |
| `sort` | Any field of the rows, such as `"name"`. | The field to order the rows by, named as Massive names it, such as `"ex_dividend_date"`. Where the endpoint allows, name several, separated by commas, each with an optional `.asc` or `.desc`: `"ticker,ex_dividend_date.desc"`. This page lists the values the dataset takes. |
| `order` | The direction of `sort`. | The direction of `sort`: `dm.Order.ASC` or `dm.Order.DESC`. |
| `limit` | The most rows to return, in total. | The most rows Massive returns for the whole request, across every symbol you name, kept in Massive's order: ask for newest first (`order=dm.Order.DESC`) to keep the latest. A symbol that comes first can use up the whole limit, so leave `limit` out when you need every row of each symbol. A `fetch()` that follows a table of symbols applies it to each symbol's request, and this dataset's own line says where else it applies to each symbol. |
| `filters` | Further endpoint parameters. | Any other parameter Massive documents for this dataset, as a mapping from the parameter's name to its value, with each dot in the name written as `_`: Massive's `strike_price.gte` is `strike_price_gte`. This page lists the keys the dataset takes. A key it doesn't take, or one that has its own argument, such as `start`, raises `ValueError` naming the keys it does take. A date or time value takes ISO 8601 text, or any value `start` takes. |

## Columns

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Abbreviation` | String | A commonly-used abbreviation for this condition. | REST |
| `AssetClass` | String | An identifier for a group of similar financial instruments. | REST |
| `DataTypes` | String[] | Data types that this condition applies to. | REST |
| `Description` | String | A short description of the semantics of this condition. | REST |
| `Exchange` | long | If present, mapping this condition from a Massive code to a SIP symbol depends on this attribute. In other words, data with this condition attached comes exclusively from the given exchange. | REST |
| `Id` | long | An identifier used by Massive for this condition. Unique per data type. | REST |
| `Legacy` | boolean | If true, this condition is from an old version of the SIPs' specs and no longer is used. Other conditions may or may not reuse the same symbol as this one. | REST |
| `Name` | String | The name of this condition. | REST |
| `SipMappingCta` | String | Condition code from the Consolidated Tape Association (CTA). From the `sip_mapping` object: A comprehensive mapping that translates condition codes from individual SIPs (CTA, OPRA, UTP) to a unified code used by Massive. This facilitates consistent interpretation and application of market data conditions across different data streams, ensuring that users can accurately apply these conditions to their data analysis and reporting. | REST |
| `SipMappingOpra` | String | Condition code from the Options Price Reporting Authority (OPRA). From the `sip_mapping` object: A comprehensive mapping that translates condition codes from individual SIPs (CTA, OPRA, UTP) to a unified code used by Massive. This facilitates consistent interpretation and application of market data conditions across different data streams, ensuring that users can accurately apply these conditions to their data analysis and reporting. | REST |
| `SipMappingUtp` | String | Condition code from UTP Plan (UTP). From the `sip_mapping` object: A comprehensive mapping that translates condition codes from individual SIPs (CTA, OPRA, UTP) to a unified code used by Massive. This facilitates consistent interpretation and application of market data conditions across different data streams, ensuring that users can accurately apply these conditions to their data analysis and reporting. | REST |
| `SipMappingFinraTdds` | String | Condition code from FINRA's Trade Data Dissemination Service (TDDS). From the `sip_mapping` object: A comprehensive mapping that translates condition codes from individual SIPs (CTA, OPRA, UTP) to a unified code used by Massive. This facilitates consistent interpretation and application of market data conditions across different data streams, ensuring that users can accurately apply these conditions to their data analysis and reporting. | REST |
| `Type` | String | An identifier for a collection of related conditions. | REST |
| `UpdateRulesConsolidatedUpdatesHighLow` | boolean | Whether or not trades with this condition update the high/low. From the `update_rules` object: A list of aggregation rules. From the `update_rules.consolidated` object: Describes aggregation rules on a consolidated (all exchanges) basis. | REST |
| `UpdateRulesConsolidatedUpdatesOpenClose` | boolean | Whether or not trades with this condition update the open/close. From the `update_rules` object: A list of aggregation rules. From the `update_rules.consolidated` object: Describes aggregation rules on a consolidated (all exchanges) basis. | REST |
| `UpdateRulesConsolidatedUpdatesVolume` | boolean | Whether or not trades with this condition update the volume. From the `update_rules` object: A list of aggregation rules. From the `update_rules.consolidated` object: Describes aggregation rules on a consolidated (all exchanges) basis. | REST |
| `UpdateRulesMarketCenterUpdatesHighLow` | boolean | Whether or not trades with this condition update the high/low. From the `update_rules` object: A list of aggregation rules. From the `update_rules.market_center` object: Describes aggregation rules on a per-market-center basis. | REST |
| `UpdateRulesMarketCenterUpdatesOpenClose` | boolean | Whether or not trades with this condition update the open/close. From the `update_rules` object: A list of aggregation rules. From the `update_rules.market_center` object: Describes aggregation rules on a per-market-center basis. | REST |
| `UpdateRulesMarketCenterUpdatesVolume` | boolean | Whether or not trades with this condition update the volume. From the `update_rules` object: A list of aggregation rules. From the `update_rules.market_center` object: Describes aggregation rules on a per-market-center basis. | REST |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. | REST |
